purpose: 8-level public itch.io Demo uses 11 whole-animal sprites, no colored geometry placeholders in released game. First batch tackle hardest shapes to reduce art-fit risk.
workflow: ART selects original species and poses for each shape; draw one COMPLETE autonomous animal per shape, never split into body parts; keep heavy dark outline, playful features, vivid color blocks. HUMAN approves each final image (G3). Do not redraw existing approved panda RECT6 or rabbit O4. Do not force influencer-animal story choice; narrative deferred.
outputs: Original RGBA PNG with occupancy map and anchor metadata + G3 handoff for each approved candidate; local asset folder C:/Users/Administrator/Desktop/动物拼图美术素材/
safety: Shape occupancy is strict but species/pose creatively chosen by ART. Avoid unworkable hidden occupied cells, silhouettes interfering with next cells, or constrained realistic anatomy. Revisit shape only with DESIGN permission.
